correctness.rationale: At the unique constant optimum, derivatives of the two exact log-sum-exp blocks are -tau W and -tau W^T; the third exact KL gauge derivative is half the difference of the block means, yielding uniform eigenvalue -tau(1-tau)/2 and nonuniform multipliers tau^2 sigma_j(W)^2. Strict positivity of the doubly stochastic W gives sigma_perp<1. Every parameter case and equality boundary is handled algebraically; 42 independently computed Jacobians confirm local formulas but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The exact balanced-kernel crossover sharpens a motivating empirical numerical observation into a universal parameter rule, identifies a previously nonobvious negative mass mode, and provides a separate singular-value-controlled transition. Circulant and translation-invariant positive kernels are natural numerical test cases; knowing the extra maximization can worsen the local rate guides actual solver choice. This is not a trivial general textbook corollary without deriving the gauge derivative.
